openQuestions.q: PLAN claims lattice.config.json is canonical, but project-root resolution duplicates (cli-engine.ts:1716-1719, dev-memory.ts:169, dashboard.ts:260, cli-init.ts:707-736, core/dirty-worktree.ts:282) only know about koala.config.json. Does CHK-002 scope cover those, or is the design boundary: lattice.config.json is content-overlay only and project-root marker stays koala.config.json (so a repo MUST still have koala.config.json present)? If the former, scope-contract.allowedModify needs cli-engine.ts/dev-memory.ts/dashboard.ts/cli-init.ts/dirty-worktree.ts added.
openQuestions.evidence: grep koala.config.json across packages/main/src returned hardcoded markers at cli-engine.ts:1716-1719 (resolveProjectRoot duplicate of core/config.ts), dev-memory.ts:169 (project root walker), dashboard.ts:260-261 (no koala.config.json found guard), cli-init.ts:707/736 (scaffold writes koala.config.json), core/dirty-worktree.ts:282 (classifier config-file list); none are in PLAN modify scope.
openQuestions.resolution: Resolved: lattice.config.json is not content-overlay only; it is the canonical config and project-root marker. B-38d6 scope now explicitly includes cli-engine.ts, core/dev-memory.ts, handlers/dev-memory.ts, dashboard.ts, cli-init.ts, and core/dirty-worktree.ts so root detection, diagnostics, init scaffolding, and dirty classification recognize lattice.config.json while retaining koala.config.json as legacy fallback. This follows the chosen decision option: canonical Lattice naming with backward compatibility, not a hard rename.

openQuestions.q: cli-init.ts:707/736 currently scaffolds koala.config.json for new repos. If lattice.config.json is canonical (CHK-002) and docs (CHK-003) point maintainers to it, should new repos generated by lattice init produce lattice.config.json (canonical) instead, with koala.config.json reserved for legacy? PLAN does not list cli-init.ts under CHK-002/003 scope.
